facts.anchor: I named it after you, Daddy. It felt right.

facts.fact: 婚后第一个夏天：湖边柠檬水与冰棒，一如当年；三年前有人这样说她会骂对方疯了。
facts.anchor: We spend most of our time at the lake, drinking lemonade and eating popsicles, just as we used to.

facts.fact: 戒指的重量不再沉——正如这段新的婚姻。
Bailey 终于软化了：congratulations、proud of you——baby steps。
结尾：湖边 "On three?"——一、二、三，然后我们跳下去（ch07 悬崖跳水的回声）。
